text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service `inference-prod` (PD incident PD-81234) — urgency: high. Trigger: high error rate on v2 serving nodes. Link: https://pd.redwood/pd/PD-81234

PagerDuty: PagerDuty automated note: page sent to rotation `inference-oncall` and `platform-oncall` (2 targets). Escalation policy: default.

Alex: acked. I'm on it, taking primary.

Maria: @Alex ping — I just got a page too, looks like duplicate firing. Are those different services?

Alex: looks like the alert rule references `service: inference-prod` but the PD TVAR includes a legacy tag that routes a duplicate copy to `platform-oncall`. investigating routing rules now.

Sandeep: can someone add customer impact? I see increased 5xxs from the ingestion queue.

DevOps Sara: Confirming: logs show `kv-cache` eviction spikes + model worker OOMs between 02:34-02:38 UTC. Sample logs: ```[02:35:12 INF] worker-7 evicted KV cache (size=8GB)
[02:36:03 ERR] model-worker-7 OOM: attempted allocate 1.2GB```

Product Ben: Any users affected? Are production API latencies spiking?

Alex: Yes, p50 -> p95 increased; we saw customer errors for ~4% of requests for ~6m. Not full outage but visible errors. I'm going to silence the duplicate page target to stop platform team noise while we triage.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: Alex acknowledged PD-81234 at 2024-11-02T02:40:10Z. Escalation to next level scheduled at +10m if unack.

Maria: FYI I saw the duplicate routing in the PD binding: `service: inference-prod` had both `tag: inference` and legacy tag `team:platform` in routing rules. That explains two pages.

Sandeep: Temporary mitigation: switching inference service auto-scale policy to `max_workers + 2` and enabling swap to high-memory worker pool. Running command now: ```kubectl -n inference set resources deployment/model-worker --limits=memory=10Gi```

DevOps Sara: I'm flipping the PD binding to remove `team:platform` for `inference-prod` to stop future duplicate pages. Command (pd cli): ```pd service update inference-prod --remove-tag team:platform```

PagerDuty: PD event: routing change triggered — `team:platform` removed from `inference-prod` bindings by DevOps Sara. Duplicate page suppression in effect.

Miguel: Noted. I've also added a temporary alert suppression for noisy OOM spikes (60s window) to avoid further repeat pages while we stabilize.

Alex: After scaling and routing fix, errors dropped back to baseline around 02:46 UTC. Customer-visible errors lasted ~12 minutes total.

Product Ben: I'll notify affected customers with a brief update: small burst of 5xxs, mitigated, follow-up in postmortem.

Maria: Action items: 1) remove legacy tags from PD bindings (already in progress), 2) add unit test in alerting CI to detect duplicate route tags, 3) postmortem with root cause of KV eviction/OOM.

Sandeep: Logging follow-up: capture heap profiles for model-worker under burst load and add guardrail to avoid aggressive KV eviction policy.

incident-bot: Incident PD-81234 resolved by Alex at 2024-11-02T03:05:10Z. Summary: duplicate paging due to legacy routing tag caused noise; underlying cause: KV cache eviction -> model-worker OOM under burst. Mitigations: scaled workers + routing fix + temporary suppression. Postmortem assigned to Sandeep.

Alex: thanks everyone — dropping handoff. If anything resurfaces ping me in #eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
